title: Direct Mechanism Interface
body_html:
Direct Mechanism Interface

A direct mechanism for agents \(I\), report spaces \(T_i\), and outcomes \(O\) maps reported types to an outcome. It induces a strategic game by taking reports as strategies and evaluating outcomes through externally supplied utilities.

This node records the direct revelation structure itself. The induced strategic game, DSIC predicate, and ex-post individual rationality predicate are separate basic mechanism-design nodes because they add additional payoff or order structure.

References

  • [AGT, Chapter 9, Def. 9.14] Nisan, Roughgarden, Tardos, and Vazirani, Algorithmic Game Theory, references/AlgorithmicGameTheory.pdf. Direct-revelation mechanisms and report spaces.
  • [MFoGT, Chapter 1, Section 1.1.3] Maschler, Solan, and Zamir, Game Theory, references/GameTheory.pdf. Social-choice and mechanism-design context for outcome rules.
